subject: What a live harness's own receipt records when the harness drives the product through `resources/read`
question: When a harness reads the product only through `resources/read`, which of its operations does the evidence receipt record?

host.note: project lpm-locale-campaign.logicx; Logic switched to English for this run

reverify.expected: 9 of 9 checks pass and the receipt records 7 operations, 6 of them `resources/read` on `logic://mixer`

method: Ran the #291 output harness against a live Logic at head a88f49e0 with the release binary, then read the operation records out of the evidence document it wrote.

observations.what: the operations the receipt recorded, in order
how many of those the PREVIOUS rule would have counted — it recorded `tools/call` only

conclusion: Six of the seven operations are `resources/read`, and the previous rule recorded none of them. This run would have scored `operations_driven: 1` under that rule — the single `refresh_cache` tool call — so it would have passed `is_clean`'s positive-count clause while its receipt named none of the six reads that produced the answer. That is the sharper statement than the issue's: the clause was satisfiable here by a warm-up call, and the work was absent from the document.
limits: One harness, one project, one locale. It says nothing about harnesses that mix the two surfaces differently.

It does NOT reproduce the `operations_driven: 0` documents #769 cites. Those were earlier revisions of the #291 harnesses; this revision makes a `refresh_cache` tool call, so the old rule would have counted 1 rather than 0 here. The zero is quoted from the issue, not re-measured.

This record does NOT say whether the mixer read returned a correct destination. That is the harness's own subject and its nine checks are where it is asserted; nothing here carries a destination value, so the verdict is about the RECEIPT and reaches no further. A review refused an earlier version of this record for a `question` that asked about both while the observations answered one.

The receipt records a resource read whether or not the resource touched Logic — some are served statically. Counting one rules out a run that touched nothing; it does not show the run drove its own subject.
